service.description: A step of a template tree (rootWorkEffortId, a WorkEffort with isTemplate Y and a process policy in effect): new (workEffortName; under parentWorkEffortId, a node of the same tree, else the root) or changed (workEffortId), with its step policy from now (isRequired, roleTypeId, dueOffsetDays; a change ends the policy in effect and starts the next), and the steps of the same tree it waits for (dependsOnIds; a cycle or another tree's step is refused, DEPENDENCY_INVALID). With end, the step's policy ends now: the step is left out of new executions. Needs the permission of the policy using the process (PERMISSION_DENIED; PROCESS_UNAVAILABLE for a template with no policy in effect).

parameter.name: purposeEnumId
parameter.description: A new step's purpose; the root's when empty

service.description: A template (templateWorkEffortId: isTemplate Y, its process policy in effect) made into fresh work by the two-pass copy of design-maintenance §4.2: the root and each step whose policy is in effect (an ended step left out with its sub-steps) copied with their definition fields only (the template flag, status, resolution, actual dates, effort and recurrence reset; due dates from each step's offset after startDate, now when empty), the WeatDependsOn edges inside the tree remapped, one WeatBasedOn association from each new node to its template node, the step and process policies copied, and each step assigned (Assignee) to the party roleParties names for its role (a role named for no one stays a requirement). rootFields override the root's workEffortName, description and ownerPartyId. One tree in the caller's transaction; a retry with operationKey answers the first root (repeated). Needs the permission of the policy using the process.

parameter.name: idMap
parameter.description: Each template node's id to its new node's

service.description: The managed-work rule (impl-people §4, impl-maintenance §4, in the same words): the generic task and work-effort services refuse a root that has a MaintenanceWorkOrder row and its steps, and work whose process policy guards execution (MANAGED_WORK): its own policy, its root's or its parent's. People's checklist tasks stay ordinary tasks (People's policy does not guard). A data check, for any caller; reads nothing else.
